title: Baghdad Phantom mission report released early (was due for declassification in 2047)

tellings.quote: mission report from the Baghdad Phantom. That was supposed to be declassified in 2047.

plain: A journalist and filmmaker named Jeremy Corbell, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, talks about a military mission report on a case known as the Baghdad Phantom, set in Baghdad, Iraq. Corbell says the report was not supposed to be declassified, meaning made public, until 2047, but that it has come out early. If that is so, it would mean records about this case are reaching the public decades ahead of schedule.
